title: Illustrated wrapper typography detail
slide_intent: Evaluate expressive lettering on the folded object because creases and curvature change what a customer can read.
strategic_value: Large colorful words on white wrappers can retain Burger King character even when the paper bunches around food.
demonstration: A close overhead crop centers a red Hearty Melty wrapper among green, orange, yellow and red lettered packages on a brown surface.
practical_value: Check the readability and shape coverage of the central lettering after wrapping, rather than assessing only flat artwork.

content_islands.name: Central wrapper
content_islands.spec: Give the red Hearty Melty round the largest uninterrupted area near the center-left.

content_islands.name: Surrounding variants
content_islands.spec: Crop other lettered packages at the edges to show the family’s color and word-shape variations.

content_islands.name: Material evidence
content_islands.spec: Retain paper wrinkles, folds and shadows that reveal the typography on physical packaging.

reference_purposes.Expression: The crop emphasizes oversized food-descriptive lettering and distinct package colors.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph tests the lettering treatment on crumpled, folded wrappers.
